name: Nodira
role: Poet and queen regent in the Khanate of Kokand
contribution: A poet in the Khanate of Kokand, who wrote in Chagatai Turkic and Persian.
legacy: Her writings, numbering nearly 10,000 verses, include a divan featuring 136 poems in Chaghatai and 44 in Persian.

checks.lead: Nodira (also spelled Nadira; 1792–1842) was a poet in the Khanate of Kokand, who wrote in Chagatai Turkic and Persian.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
